mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 35 degree temperatures near Verona Area High School, with a full moon visible above the clouds.

For city business, candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are available at the City Clerk office with a deadline of January 5. Also, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, with the first installment due by January 31.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch the Thursday night festivities at ART House 360. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and the 50th anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
During the period from November 1 to November 15, Verona officers responded to several incidents, including an O W I arrest and reports of a stolen vehicle.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
